cond_0168.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. You will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, spot trends, and find improvement opportunities. A regular part of the job is connecting with leadership, functional business owners, and other staff to understand friction points in data and recommend improvements to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0168.responsibilities:
Actively contribute to the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models, and stay engaged with ongoing efforts to improve model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Speak up and contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language and utilities industry terminology, including safety metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies for business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Conduct data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings directly to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or actively participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reports to stakeholders.
Update data visualizations and dashboards on an ongoing basis.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis; contribute to data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Identify trends, draw conclusions, and summarize results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable findings.
Transform information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; connect regularly with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0168.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
SQL — basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Excel — advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Visualization tools (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) — advanced skills in at least one best-in-class data visualization tool, including data preparation, chart types (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, and dashboard creation.
Report Development — ability to create reports from multiple data sets using standard reporting software.
Basic Analytics — data profiling, data quality, joining data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, and data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development — ability to quickly develop, test, and deliver one-time information based on business requests using standard querying toolsets.
Visualization Development — ability to generate analysis through data visualizations from multiple data sets.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Ability to apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, and trends.
Advanced presentation skills, including adapting to audience and strong written and grammatical skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.).
Ability to make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions, decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with ERP software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software used to assemble business operations data (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiarity with data warehouse / data mart OLAP environments using star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar structures.
Familiarity with data modeling in the context of transforming data from OLTP to OLAP or other data warehouse structures.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning, and related analysis.
Dashboard Development — gathering requirements, identifying metrics and goals, selecting appropriate dashboard objects, and implementing dashboards using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management — ability to facilitate, create, implement, and manage projects using MS Project or a similar tool; ability to define, document, and communicate project charters, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status.
Query Optimization — ability to create or modify SQL or other query code to minimize database impact and improve execution efficiency.
Knowledge and application of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices, procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances, and laws.
Predictive Model Development — ability to leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends, with relevant statistical confidence measures and appropriate statistical methods.
Process flow documentation.
MS Access — advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation, filtering, updates, summarization, and reporting.
Reporting tools (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) — advanced skills in columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.

cond_0250.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. The analyst will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, identify trends, and surface improvement opportunities. This includes reviewing friction points in data that create unnecessary effort and recommending gap closure initiatives related to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0250.responsibilities:
Contribute to the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models; support ongoing improvement of model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to support quantitative and qualitative data-driven decisions across the organization.
Support the recommendation and auditing of best practices related to data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Document and communicate statistical findings using business terminology common to the utilities industry, including safety metrics and terminology.
Provide input to stakeholders on data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations as required by project needs.
Conduct deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Coordinate with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Perform data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; document and share findings with relevant stakeholders.
Develop a solid understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Contribute to troubleshooting and debugging efforts as assigned.
Prepare visualizations, dashboards, and reports for distribution to relevant stakeholders.
Update data visualizations and dashboards as needed.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analyses.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Produce documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Contribute to deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis; support data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Identify trends, draw conclusions, and summarize results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable outputs.
Transform information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and applicable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; respond to program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; serve as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.

cond_0267.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. You will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, spot trends, and find improvement opportunities. A regular part of the job is connecting with leadership, functional business owners, and other staff to understand friction points in data and recommend improvements to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0267.responsibilities:
Actively participate in the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models, and stay engaged with ongoing efforts to improve model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Participate in data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis, and in data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Participate in identifying trends, drawing conclusions, and summarizing results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; stay in regular contact with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0267.requirements:
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of all, but not limited to, the following:
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Visualization Development - Generate analysis through data visualizations from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class analytics software.
Query complex data structures and derive information for reporting, visualizations, and statistical analysis.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Basic Analytics - Perform basic data analysis to include data profiling, data quality, joining of data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development - Quickly develop, test, and provide ad hoc (one-time) information based on a business request leveraging internal or external data and using standard querying toolsets.
Report Development - Create reports from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class reporting software.
SQL - basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Visualization (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) - advanced skills in a best-in-class data visualization tool to include data preparation, rationalization of visualization type, standard charting (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, dashboard creation, deep understanding of user interface and effective presentation.
Excel - advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Familiarity with all, but not limited to, the following:
Enterprise resource planning (ERP) software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software programs used to assemble business operations data in the functional area of assignment (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiar with a data warehouse / data mart OLAP environment leveraging data in star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar data structures.
Familiar with data modeling in the context of transforming data from an OLTP system to an OLAP or other data warehouse related structure. Familiar with the importance of how data is modeled to support the needs of a data reporting and analysis environment.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning and related analysis.
Dashboard Development - Gather requirements, identify metrics and goals, leverage data sources, select appropriate dashboard objects, and implement a dashboard using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management - Facilitate, create, implement, and manage a project or projects using MS Project or a similar project tracking tool; ability to define, document, and communicate a project charter, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status over the course of a project.
Query Optimization - ability to create / modify SQL or other query code to ensure request has minimal impact on the target database and executes in the most efficient manner possible.
Knowledge / application of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices and procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Predictive Model Development - Leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends and providing insights with relevant statistical confidence measures and using appropriate statistical methods.
Process flow documentation.
Related industry, organizational and departmental policies, practices and procedures; legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Ability to:
Strong attention to detail.
Apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Demonstrate strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, trends, etc.
Advanced presentation skills leveraging appropriate software, adapting to audience, and excellent written and grammatical skills.
Work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Use advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.) and standard office equipment (telephone, computer, copier, etc.).
Make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions and decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
MS Access - advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation through joins, filtering, updates, and summarization, reporting.
Reporting (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) - advanced skills in standard columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation requirements, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.

cond_0321.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. You will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, spot trends, and find improvement opportunities. A regular part of the job is connecting with leadership, functional business owners, and other staff to understand friction points in data and recommend improvements to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
Actively participate in the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models, and stay engaged with ongoing efforts to improve model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Participate in data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis, and in data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Participate in identifying trends, drawing conclusions, and summarizing results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; stay in regular contact with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0321.requirements:
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of all, but not limited to, the following:
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Visualization Development - Generate analysis through data visualizations from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class analytics software.
Query complex data structures and derive information for reporting, visualizations, and statistical analysis.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Basic Analytics - Perform basic data analysis to include data profiling, data quality, joining of data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development - Quickly develop, test, and provide ad hoc (one-time) information based on a business request leveraging internal or external data and using standard querying toolsets.
Report Development - Create reports from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class reporting software.
SQL - basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Visualization (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) - advanced skills in a best-in-class data visualization tool to include data preparation, rationalization of visualization type, standard charting (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, dashboard creation, deep understanding of user interface and effective presentation.
Excel - advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Familiarity with all, but not limited to, the following:
Enterprise resource planning (ERP) software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software programs used to assemble business operations data in the functional area of assignment (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiar with a data warehouse / data mart OLAP environment leveraging data in star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar data structures.
Familiar with data modeling in the context of transforming data from an OLTP system to an OLAP or other data warehouse related structure. Familiar with the importance of how data is modeled to support the needs of a data reporting and analysis environment.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning and related analysis.
Dashboard Development - Gather requirements, identify metrics and goals, leverage data sources, select appropriate dashboard objects, and implement a dashboard using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management - Facilitate, create, implement, and manage a project or projects using MS Project or a similar project tracking tool; ability to define, document, and communicate a project charter, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status over the course of a project.
Query Optimization - ability to create / modify SQL or other query code to ensure request has minimal impact on the target database and executes in the most efficient manner possible.
Knowledge / application of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices and procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Predictive Model Development - Leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends and providing insights with relevant statistical confidence measures and using appropriate statistical methods.
Process flow documentation.
Related industry, organizational and departmental policies, practices and procedures; legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Ability to:
Strong attention to detail.
Apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Demonstrate strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, trends, etc.
Advanced presentation skills leveraging appropriate software, adapting to audience, and excellent written and grammatical skills.
Work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Use advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.) and standard office equipment (telephone, computer, copier, etc.).
Make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions and decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
MS Access - advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation through joins, filtering, updates, and summarization, reporting.
Reporting (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) - advanced skills in standard columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation requirements, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.

cond_0339.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. You will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, spot trends, and find improvement opportunities. A regular part of the job is connecting with leadership, functional business owners, and other staff to understand friction points in data and recommend improvements to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0339.responsibilities:
Actively participate in the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models, and stay engaged with ongoing efforts to improve model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Participate in data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis, and in data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Participate in identifying trends, drawing conclusions, and summarizing results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; stay in regular contact with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0339.requirements:
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of all, but not limited to, the following:
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Visualization Development - Generate analysis through data visualizations from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class analytics software.
Query complex data structures and derive information for reporting, visualizations, and statistical analysis.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Basic Analytics - Perform basic data analysis to include data profiling, data quality, joining of data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development - Quickly develop, test, and provide ad hoc (one-time) information based on a business request leveraging internal or external data and using standard querying toolsets.
Report Development - Create reports from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class reporting software.
SQL - basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Visualization (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) - advanced skills in a best-in-class data visualization tool to include data preparation, rationalization of visualization type, standard charting (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, dashboard creation, deep understanding of user interface and effective presentation.
Excel - advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Familiarity with all, but not limited to, the following:
Enterprise resource planning (ERP) software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software programs used to assemble business operations data in the functional area of assignment (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiar with a data warehouse / data mart OLAP environment leveraging data in star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar data structures.
Familiar with data modeling in the context of transforming data from an OLTP system to an OLAP or other data warehouse related structure. Familiar with the importance of how data is modeled to support the needs of a data reporting and analysis environment.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning and related analysis.
Dashboard Development - Gather requirements, identify metrics and goals, leverage data sources, select appropriate dashboard objects, and implement a dashboard using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management - Facilitate, create, implement, and manage a project or projects using MS Project or a similar project tracking tool; ability to define, document, and communicate a project charter, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status over the course of a project.
Query Optimization - ability to create / modify SQL or other query code to ensure request has minimal impact on the target database and executes in the most efficient manner possible.
Knowledge / application of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices and procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Predictive Model Development - Leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends and providing insights with relevant statistical confidence measures and using appropriate statistical methods.
Process flow documentation.
Related industry, organizational and departmental policies, practices and procedures; legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Ability to:
Strong attention to detail.
Apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Demonstrate strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, trends, etc.
Advanced presentation skills leveraging appropriate software, adapting to audience, and excellent written and grammatical skills.
Work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Use advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.) and standard office equipment (telephone, computer, copier, etc.).
Make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions and decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
MS Access - advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation through joins, filtering, updates, and summarization, reporting.
Reporting (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) - advanced skills in standard columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation requirements, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.

Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.

Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.

Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.

cond_0483.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. You will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, spot trends, and find improvement opportunities. A regular part of the job is connecting with leadership, functional business owners, and other staff to understand friction points in data and recommend improvements to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0483.responsibilities:
Actively participate in the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models, and stay engaged with ongoing efforts to improve model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Participate in data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis, and in data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Participate in identifying trends, drawing conclusions, and summarizing results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; stay in regular contact with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0483.requirements:
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of all, but not limited to, the following:
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Visualization Development - Generate analysis through data visualizations from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class analytics software.
Query complex data structures and derive information for reporting, visualizations, and statistical analysis.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Basic Analytics - Perform basic data analysis to include data profiling, data quality, joining of data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development - Quickly develop, test, and provide ad hoc (one-time) information based on a business request leveraging internal or external data and using standard querying toolsets.
Report Development - Create reports from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class reporting software.
SQL - basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Visualization (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) - advanced skills in a best-in-class data visualization tool to include data preparation, rationalization of visualization type, standard charting (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, dashboard creation, deep understanding of user interface and effective presentation.
Excel - advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Familiarity with all, but not limited to, the following:
Enterprise resource planning (ERP) software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software programs used to assemble business operations data in the functional area of assignment (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiar with a data warehouse / data mart OLAP environment leveraging data in star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar data structures.
Familiar with data modeling in the context of transforming data from an OLTP system to an OLAP or other data warehouse related structure. Familiar with the importance of how data is modeled to support the needs of a data reporting and analysis environment.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning and related analysis.
Dashboard Development - Gather requirements, identify metrics and goals, leverage data sources, select appropriate dashboard objects, and implement a dashboard using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management - Facilitate, create, implement, and manage a project or projects using MS Project or a similar project tracking tool; ability to define, document, and communicate a project charter, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status over the course of a project.
Query Optimization - ability to create / modify SQL or other query code to ensure request has minimal impact on the target database and executes in the most efficient manner possible.
Knowledge / application of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices and procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Predictive Model Development - Leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends and providing insights with relevant statistical confidence measures and using appropriate statistical methods.
Process flow documentation.
Related industry, organizational and departmental policies, practices and procedures; legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Ability to:
Strong attention to detail.
Apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Demonstrate strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, trends, etc.
Advanced presentation skills leveraging appropriate software, adapting to audience, and excellent written and grammatical skills.
Work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Use advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.) and standard office equipment (telephone, computer, copier, etc.).
Make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions and decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
MS Access - advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation through joins, filtering, updates, and summarization, reporting.
Reporting (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) - advanced skills in standard columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation requirements, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.

cond_0501.intro: We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. The role involves routine and ad-hoc analysis to identify actionable business insights, performance gaps, and root causes. You will work across a variety of data sources to assess current performance, spot trends, and find improvement opportunities. A regular part of the job is connecting with leadership, functional business owners, and other staff to understand friction points in data and recommend improvements to policy, process, and systems.
cond_0501.responsibilities:
Actively participate in the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models, and stay engaged with ongoing efforts to improve model accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Participate in data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis, and in data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Participate in identifying trends, drawing conclusions, and summarizing results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; stay in regular contact with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0501.requirements:
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of all, but not limited to, the following:
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Visualization Development - Generate analysis through data visualizations from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class analytics software.
Query complex data structures and derive information for reporting, visualizations, and statistical analysis.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Basic Analytics - Perform basic data analysis to include data profiling, data quality, joining of data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development - Quickly develop, test, and provide ad hoc (one-time) information based on a business request leveraging internal or external data and using standard querying toolsets.
Report Development - Create reports from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class reporting software.
SQL - basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Visualization (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) - advanced skills in a best-in-class data visualization tool to include data preparation, rationalization of visualization type, standard charting (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, dashboard creation, deep understanding of user interface and effective presentation.
Excel - advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Familiarity with all, but not limited to, the following:
Enterprise resource planning (ERP) software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software programs used to assemble business operations data in the functional area of assignment (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiar with a data warehouse / data mart OLAP environment leveraging data in star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar data structures.
Familiar with data modeling in the context of transforming data from an OLTP system to an OLAP or other data warehouse related structure. Familiar with the importance of how data is modeled to support the needs of a data reporting and analysis environment.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning and related analysis.
Dashboard Development - Gather requirements, identify metrics and goals, leverage data sources, select appropriate dashboard objects, and implement a dashboard using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management - Facilitate, create, implement, and manage a project or projects using MS Project or a similar project tracking tool; ability to define, document, and communicate a project charter, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status over the course of a project.
Query Optimization - ability to create / modify SQL or other query code to ensure request has minimal impact on the target database and executes in the most efficient manner possible.
Knowledge / application of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices and procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Predictive Model Development - Leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends and providing insights with relevant statistical confidence measures and using appropriate statistical methods.
Process flow documentation.
Related industry, organizational and departmental policies, practices and procedures; legal guidelines, ordinances and laws.
Ability to:
Strong attention to detail.
Apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Demonstrate strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, trends, etc.
Advanced presentation skills leveraging appropriate software, adapting to audience, and excellent written and grammatical skills.
Work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Use advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.) and standard office equipment (telephone, computer, copier, etc.).
Make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions and decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
MS Access - advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation through joins, filtering, updates, and summarization, reporting.
Reporting (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) - advanced skills in standard columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation requirements, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.

Identify trends and actionable insights to inform data-driven decisions across the organization.
Contribute to discussions on best practices for data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Communicate statistical findings clearly to stakeholders using business language common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Actively participate in discussions with stakeholders about data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a way that influences decisions and outcomes.
Engage in deep data analysis, research, and studies related to business discovery use cases.
Collaborate daily with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Participate in data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead or participate in troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Generate documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Participate in deep data profiling efforts to understand raw data available for analysis, and in data mining as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends.
Participate in identifying trends, drawing conclusions, and summarizing results from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Participate in transforming information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Coordinate assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; stay in regular contact with program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and recommend or implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.

Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of all, but not limited to, the following:
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.

In this role, you will own routine and ad-hoc analysis to surface actionable business insights, identify performance gaps, and execute root cause analysis. You will drive in-depth research across a variety of data sources to determine current performance, identify trends, and deliver improvement opportunities. You will lead engagement with leadership, functional business owners, and other personnel to pinpoint friction points in data that cause unnecessary effort, and direct gap closure initiatives across policy, process, and systems.
cond_0620.responsibilities:
Own the creation, validation, and implementation of statistical models. Drive improvement of model performance over time to ensure accuracy, statistical confidence, and alignment with business goals.
Identify trends and actionable insights to inform and enable qualitative and quantitative data-driven decisions across the organization.
Lead the recommendation, promotion, and auditing of best practices related to data usage, reporting standards, dashboard formats, visualization style, and analysis methods.
Deliver communication of statistical findings using business acumen and vernacular common to the utilities industry, including safety terminology and metrics.
Lead discussions with stakeholders regarding data, analyses, visualizations, conclusions, and recommendations in a manner that influences decisions and outcomes.
Execute deep data analysis, research, and studies relative to business discovery use cases.
Direct collaboration with I.T. And external consultants on decisions related to data modeling, dimensionality, data granularity, fit-for-use architecture, and overall data governance.
Drive data mining for new business insights; interpret data; draw conclusions; deliver findings to relevant stakeholders.
Build and maintain a strong understanding of data sources, relationships, and best practice usage.
Lead troubleshooting and debugging efforts.
Prepare and present visualizations, dashboards, and reporting.
Update data visualizations and dashboards.
Identify and escalate data anomalies that might affect accuracy.
Verify information integrity of reports, dashboards, and analysis.
Generate scheduled and ad hoc reports.
Produce documentation related to reporting and analysis development, implementation, and support.
Execute deep data profiling efforts to gain an understanding of raw data available for analysis. Drive data mining efforts as part of data science or machine learning exercises to identify themes and trends for further analysis.
Identify trends, draw conclusions, and summarize results derived from data analysis to produce business-relevant and actionable conclusions.
Transform information into actionable insights.
Perform routine research and analysis to identify data trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Own assigned departmental programs, projects, and activities; respond to program customers to identify needs and resolve issues; act as a resource for other departments.
Identify and research gaps in departmental programs; identify opportunities and implement improvements.
Research and recommend new technologies, programs, and procedures.
Support operational software and technical applications related to the department.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0620.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Able to prioritize and coordinate multiple projects to meet deadlines.
SQL — basic query and data manipulation skills including selects, inserts, updates, table joins, and grouping.
Visualization (Qlik, PowerBI, Cognos, Tableau) — advanced skills in a best-in-class data visualization tool including data preparation, rationalization of visualization type, standard charting (time series, Pareto, bar, area, multi-axis, geospatial, scatter plots, etc.), filtering, drill-downs, drill-throughs, navigation, dashboard creation, deep understanding of user interface and effective presentation.
Excel — advanced skills including graphing, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and multi-sheet references.
Experience working with a best-in-class DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) to extract and transform data for reporting, analysis, or data science.
Basic Analytics — data profiling, data quality, joining of data tables, graphing, basic trend analysis, data segmentation.
Ad Hoc Query Development — quickly develop, test, and provide ad hoc information based on a business request using standard querying toolsets.
Report Development — create reports from multiple data sets using standard best-in-class reporting software.
Processes for leveraging data from data warehousing / data mart / data lake environments.
Requirements gathering and analysis.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to apply data quality assurance and troubleshooting to data profiling, analysis, and reporting.
Ability to apply appropriate data cleansing and transformation techniques to prepare data for reporting and analysis.
Strong analytical ability to identify appropriate analysis, data anomalies, trends, etc.
Work with minimal supervision; self-directed; seeks assistance when needed.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Advanced Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.) and standard office equipment.
Ability to make arithmetic computations using whole numbers, fractions and decimals, rates, ratios, and percentages.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with ERP software ([Product name masked]) and specialty software programs used to assemble business operations data in the functional area of assignment (billing, budget, accounting, workforce management, etc.).
Familiar with a data warehouse / data mart OLAP environment leveraging data in star schemas, snowflake schemas, and similar data structures.
Familiar with data modeling in the context of transforming data from an OLTP system to an OLAP or other data warehouse related structure, and the importance of how data is modeled to support reporting and analysis.
Familiarity with generally accepted data and information privacy standards (GDPR, PCI, PII, HIPAA, etc.).
Familiarity with leveraging large data sets for data science, machine learning, and related analysis.
Dashboard Development — gather requirements, identify metrics and goals, leverage data sources, select appropriate dashboard objects, and implement a dashboard using a best-in-class tool.
Project Management — facilitate, create, implement, and manage a project using MS Project or a similar tool; ability to define, document, and communicate a project charter, resource assignments, risks, issues, and status.
Query Optimization — ability to create/modify SQL or other query code to ensure minimal impact on the target database and efficient execution.
Predictive Model Development — leverage historic internal and external data to generate predictive business models forecasting trends and providing insights with relevant statistical confidence measures.
Process flow documentation.
Knowledge of related industry, organizational, and departmental policies, practices and procedures, legal guidelines, ordinances, and laws.
MS Access — advanced skills including relational table joins, data transformation through joins, filtering, updates, summarization, and reporting.
Reporting (Cognos, OBIEE, Crystal) — advanced skills in standard columnar reporting, requirements gathering, data preparation, report creation, testing, scheduling, and deployment.
Advanced presentation skills leveraging appropriate software, adapting to audience, and excellent written and grammatical skills.
